encoding_from_label.brief: 把字符集标签映射为解码器枚举 / Map a charset label to the decoder enumeration

params.label: 字符集标签，如 `utf-8`、`iso-8859-1` / Charset label such as `utf-8` or `iso-8859-1`
params.len: 标签字节数 / Label byte count

encoding_from_label.details: 识别 `utf-8`/`utf8`、`iso-8859-1`/`latin1`/`windows-1252`/`cp1252`/`iso8859-1`、`utf-16`/`utf-16le` 与 `utf-16be`；标签大小写不敏感。| Recognises `utf-8`/`utf8`, `iso-8859-1`/`latin1`/`windows-1252`/`cp1252`/`iso8859-1`, `utf-16`/`utf-16le` and `utf-16be`; the label is matched case-insensitively.
encoding_from_label.note: 无法识别的标签回退为 utf-8（规范默认值）/ An unrecognised label falls back to utf-8, the spec default

sniff_meta_charset.brief: 从前 1024 字节中嗅探 `<meta charset>` 声明 / Sniff a `<meta charset>` declaration from the first 1024 bytes

params.raw: 原始文档字节 / Raw document bytes
params.len: 原始字节数 / Raw byte count
params.found: out:置 1 表示确实找到声明，可为 `NULL` / Set to 1 when a declaration was actually found, may be `NULL`

sniff_meta_charset.return: 声明指定的编码，未找到时为 utf-8 / The declared encoding, or utf-8 when none was found
sniff_meta_charset.details: 宽松匹配：既接受 `<meta charset=...>`，也接受 `content="text/html; charset=..."`，做法是直接搜索 `charset` 关键字。| Matching is deliberately lenient: both `<meta charset=...>` and `content="text/html; charset=..."` are accepted by searching for the bare `charset` keyword.
sniff_meta_charset.note: 只扫描前 `HPE_SNIFF_BYTES`（1024）字节 / Only the first `HPE_SNIFF_BYTES` (1024) bytes are scanned

is_valid_utf8.brief: 严格校验一段字节是否为合法 UTF-8 / Strictly validate whether a byte run is well-formed UTF-8

params.s: 待校验字节 / Bytes to validate

is_valid_utf8.return: 合法 UTF-8 返回 1 / 1 when the bytes are valid UTF-8
is_valid_utf8.details: 拒绝过长编码、代理对（U+D800~U+DFFF）与超出 U+10FFFF 的码点，从而能把 latin-1 字节流正确区分开。| Over-long forms, surrogates (U+D800 to U+DFFF) and code points above U+10FFFF are rejected, which is what lets a latin-1 stream be told apart from utf-8.
is_valid_utf8.note: 用于无声明时在 utf-8 与 latin-1 之间做抉择 / Used to choose between utf-8 and latin-1 when the document declares nothing

utf16_to_utf8.brief: 把 UTF-16 字节流转码为 UTF-8 / Transcode a UTF-16 byte stream to UTF-8

params.raw: UTF-16 原始字节 / Raw UTF-16 bytes
params.len: 原始字节数 / Raw byte count
params.out_len: out:结果的 UTF-8 字节数，可为 `NULL` / Result byte count, may be `NULL`

utf16_to_utf8.return: 新分配且以 NUL 结尾的 UTF-8 字符串 / Newly allocated NUL-terminated UTF-8 string
utf16_to_utf8.details: 正确合并 UTF-16 代理对（高代理 `D800`~`DBFF` + 低代理 `DC00`~`DFFF`）为单个码点。| Surrogate pairs (high `D800` to `DBFF` plus low `DC00` to `DFFF`) are combined into a single code point.
utf16_to_utf8.note: 输出缓冲按输入长度 × 3 + 1 分配；调用方负责释放 / The output is allocated at three times the input length plus one; the caller owns it

detect_bom.brief: 探测字节序标记并报告其隐含编码 / Detect a byte order mark and report the encoding it implies

params.enc: out:写入 BOM 隐含的编码 / Receives the encoding implied by the BOM

detect_bom.return: BOM 占用的字节数，无 BOM 时 0 / Number of bytes the BOM occupies, 0 when there is none
detect_bom.details: 识别 UTF-8 BOM（`EF BB BF`）、UTF-16LE（`FF FE`）与 UTF-16BE（`FE FF`）。| Recognises the UTF-8 BOM (`EF BB BF`), UTF-16LE (`FF FE`) and UTF-16BE (`FE FF`).
detect_bom.note: utf-8 没有独立的编码差别，但其 BOM 仍需被跳过 / utf-8 has no encoding of its own, yet its BOM still has to be skipped

empty_string.brief: 返回一个空字符串 / Return an empty string
empty_string.return: 新分配的单字节空串 / A newly allocated single-byte empty string
empty_string.note: 用于 `NULL` 或空输入的场合，使返回值永不为 `NULL` / Used for `NULL` or empty input so that the caller never receives `NULL`

decode_by_bom.brief: 按 BOM 解码文档字节 / Decode document bytes according to the BOM

params.enc: inout:读入 BOM 隐含的编码 / Carries the encoding implied by the BOM
params.out_len: out:结果的 UTF-8 字节数，可为 `NULL` / Result byte count, may be `NULL`
params.out_enc: out:最终使用的编码，可为 `NULL` / Encoding finally used, may be `NULL`

decode_by_bom.return: UTF-16 输入返回转码结果；无 BOM 或 UTF-8 BOM 返回 `NULL` / The transcoded result for UTF-16 input, or `NULL` for no BOM or a UTF-8 BOM
decode_by_bom.note: UTF-8 BOM 返回 `NULL` 表示由调用方剥掉 BOM 后继续后续嗅探 / A `NULL` return for a UTF-8 BOM tells the caller to strip it and continue sniffing

decode_by_meta.brief: 按文档内 `<meta charset>` 声明解码 / Decode using the in-document `<meta charset>` declaration

params.out_len: out:结果的 UTF-8 字节数，可为 `NULL` / Result byte count, may be `NULL`
params.out_enc: out:最终使用的编码，可为 `NULL` / Encoding finally used, may be `NULL`
params.out_from_meta: out:置 1 表示编码来自文档内声明 / Set to 1 when the encoding came from the in-document declaration
params.handled: out:置 1 表示本函数已给出结果 / Set to 1 when this function produced a result

decode_by_meta.return: 声明为 UTF-16 时返回转码结果，否则 `NULL` / The transcoded result for a UTF-16 declaration, otherwise `NULL`
decode_by_meta.note: 声明为 UTF-8 或 latin-1 时 `handled` 为 0，交由后续嗅探处理 / For a UTF-8 or latin-1 declaration `handled` stays 0 and later sniffing takes over

decode_by_sniff.brief: 无声明时按内容嗅探解码 / Decode by content sniffing when the document declares nothing

params.out_len: out:结果的 UTF-8 字节数，可为 `NULL` / Result byte count, may be `NULL`
params.out_enc: out:最终使用的编码，可为 `NULL` / Encoding finally used, may be `NULL`

decode_by_sniff.return: 新分配且以 NUL 结尾的 UTF-8 字符串 / Newly allocated NUL-terminated UTF-8 string
decode_by_sniff.details: 通过 `is_valid_utf8` 判断：合法按 utf-8 原样复制，否则按 latin-1/cp1252 转码。| Uses `is_valid_utf8`: valid bytes are copied as-is, otherwise the stream is transcoded from latin-1/cp1252.

hpe_html_decode.brief: 把原始文档字节解码为 UTF-8 / Decode a raw document byte buffer into UTF-8

params.raw: 原始文档字节，为 `NULL` 时返回空串 / Raw document bytes; a `NULL` value yields an empty string
params.len: 原始字节数 / Raw byte count
params.out_len: out:结果的 UTF-8 字节数，可为 `NULL` / Result byte count, may be `NULL`
params.out_enc: out:探测到的编码，可为 `NULL` / Detected encoding, may be `NULL`
params.out_from_meta: out:置 1 表示编码来自文档内声明，可为 `NULL` / Set to 1 when the encoding came from an in-document declaration, may be `NULL`

hpe_html_decode.return: 新分配且以 NUL 结尾的 UTF-8 字符串，永不返回 `NULL` / Newly allocated NUL-terminated UTF-8 string, never `NULL`
hpe_html_decode.details: 嗅探顺序即 HTML 规范规定的顺序：BOM 优先，其次是前 1024 字节内的 `<meta charset>`（或 `http-equiv="content-type"`），最后用严格的 utf-8 校验在 utf-8 与 latin-1 之间抉择。| The sniff order follows the HTML spec: a BOM wins, then `<meta charset>` (or `http-equiv="content-type"`) within the first 1024 bytes, and finally a strict utf-8 validation decides between utf-8 and latin-1.
hpe_html_decode.note: 调用方负责用 `hpe_free` 释放返回值；UTF-8 BOM 会被剥掉 / The caller frees the result with `hpe_free`; a UTF-8 BOM is stripped

hpe_encoding_name.brief: 取得编码的小写名称 / Obtain the lowercase name of an encoding

params.enc: 待命名的编码 / Encoding to name

hpe_encoding_name.note: 供开发/测试钩子使用的标签 / A label used by the dev and test hooks
